mission: To empower individuals to achieve their health and fitness goals through instantly generated, personalized meal and workout plans powered by AI.
targetAudience: Individuals seeking convenient, customized, and effective solutions for weight loss, muscle building, and overall fitness improvement.
customerPersonas: The Busy Professional: Lacks time for extensive research or gym visits, needs quick, actionable health advice.
The Fitness Newbie: Overwhelmed by fitness information, needs a clear, guided plan to start their journey.
The Goal-Oriented Individual: Has specific fitness objectives (e.g., weight loss, muscle gain) and seeks a tailored approach to achieve them efficiently.
toneOfVoice: Encouraging, clear, direct, and knowledgeable, with a focus on simplicity and actionable advice.
coreMessages: Your personalized health plan, created in 60 seconds.
Stop guessing, start achieving with AI-powered fitness.
Customized nutrition and workouts tailored to your unique goals.
Achieve your fitness goals without the guesswork.
visualRules: Use vibrant, energetic colors that evoke health and progress.
Feature imagery of diverse individuals actively engaged in fitness or enjoying healthy meals.
Emphasize clarity and ease of use in all visual communication.
doNotUseRules: Avoid overly complex or cluttered designs.
Do not use generic stock photos that lack authenticity.
Refrain from using overly technical jargon that might alienate users.
Avoid imagery that promotes unhealthy or extreme fitness standards.
